# 1.2.56 - boxes in the handbooks, glass that fits

The handbooks got easier to skim, the two panels on the right got wider, and
the Stained Glass curtain now cuts cleanly on every screen size it was tried on.
Nothing here asks a world to be migrated.

## New

- **The handbooks read better.** The GM Handbook, the Player Handbook and the
  Student Brochure, in English and Polish, now use coloured boxes for notes,
  tips, rules people miss, warnings and the irreversible, plus tables where a
  list was really a table, bold for the terms and numbers you look up, and an
  underline on the one condition a rule turns on. Nothing in them changed but
  the layout. The book button draws all of it, in both themes, and GitHub shows
  the same boxes.
- **Wider status and Projects panels (Stained Glass).** The panel with Still to
  act, your actions, Move and Hope, and the Projects tray under it, are wider,
  reaching toward Foundry's tiles: 306 to 340 px at 1920 x 1080. On a narrow
  desk they keep their old width, because the Despair rail leaves no room.

## Fixed

- **The curtain on smaller screens.** Between 1152 and 1400 px wide, the glass
  was cut wrong: the Projects tray shared a pane with the Despair rail, strips
  of bare map showed at the screen's edges, and on a stacked screen the tray's
  glass ran into the status panel. All three are fixed. Checked on 22 screen
  sizes from 820 x 1180 to 2560 x 1440: no overlap, no block off its glass, no
  gap at any edge.
- **Screens narrower than 1224 px now use the stacked layout** (it was 1200).
  Between 1200 and 1216 px the Despair rail and the status panel stood 10 px on
  top of each other.

The regression tests for these changes (R111, R112) and the curtain, glass,
narrow-layout, accessibility and translation tests pass on a live world. The
full suite was not rerun for this release; it last passed 276 of 276 on 1.2.54.
